exercise.title: Effektivwert
exercise.solution_path:
- $0\leq t \leq T: $

\[ u(t)=\hat{U}\left(\frac{2t}{T}-1 \right) \Rightarrow \bar{u}=0
\]
\[ U^2=\frac{1}{T}\int\limits_0^T \hat{U}^2 \left(\frac{2t}{T}-1 \right)^2\mathrm{d}t =\frac{\hat{U}^2}{T}\int\limits_0^T\left(\frac{4t^2}{T^2}-\frac{4t}{T}+1 \right)\mathrm{d}t =\frac{\hat{U}^2}{T}\left(\frac{4}{3}T-2T+T \right) 
\]
\[U^2=\frac{\hat{U}^2}{3}
\]
oder 
\[ U^2=\frac{1}{T}\int\limits_0^T \hat{U}^2 \left(\frac{2t}{T}-1 \right)^2\mathrm{d}t =\frac{\hat{U}^2}{T}\cdot \frac{1}{3}\cdot\frac{T}{2} \left.\left(\frac{2t}{T}-1 \right)^3\right|_0^T =\frac{\hat{U}^2}{6}(1+1) =\frac{\hat{U}^2}{3}
\]
$\Rightarrow U=\dfrac{\hat{U}}{\sqrt{3}}$

- $0\leq t \leq T: $
\[ u(t)=\frac{\hat{U}t^2}{T^2} \Rightarrow \bar{u}=\frac{1}{T}\int\limits_0^T \frac{\hat{U}t^2}{T^2} \mathrm{d}t=\frac{\hat{U}}{3}
\]
\[U^2=\frac{1}{T}\int\limits_0^T \hat{U}^2 \left(\frac{t}{T} \right)^4 \mathrm{d}t=\frac{\hat{U}^2 T}{5T}=\frac{\hat{U}^2}{5} \Rightarrow U=\frac{\hat{U}}{\sqrt{5}}
\]

- $0\leq t \leq T: $
\[ u(t)=\hat{U}\left(1-\frac{t}{T} \right) \Rightarrow \bar{u}=\frac{\hat{U}}{2}
\]
\[ U^2=\frac{1}{T}\int\limits_0^T \hat{U}^2\left(1-\frac{t}{T} \right)^2 \mathrm{d}t= \frac{\hat{U}^2}{T}\int\limits_0^T \left(1-\frac{2t}{T}+\frac{t^2}{T^2} \right) \mathrm{d}t =\frac{\hat{U}^2}{T}\left(T-T+\frac{T}{3} \right)
\]
\[U^2=\frac{\hat{U}^2}{3}
\]
oder
\[U^2=\frac{1}{T}\int\limits_0^T \hat{U}^2\left(1-\frac{t}{T} \right)^2 \mathrm{d}t=\frac{\hat{U}^2}{T}\cdot \frac{1}{3}\cdot (-T)\cdot \left.\left(1-\frac{t}{T} \right)^3\right|_0^T = - \frac{\hat{U}^2}{3}(0-1)=\frac{\hat{U}^2}{3}
\]
$\Rightarrow U=\dfrac{\hat{U}}{\sqrt{3}}$
